title: Goats and Growing Grass | AMC 8-Style Level 5
description:
10 goats finish a field in 20 days, but 15 goats need only 10. How can 5 more goats save so many days? The grass keeps growing! Vantee counts in goat-days to find the daily growth and the starting grass, then splits the goats into helpers and pile-eaters for a second way, and gives you hungry sheep to try yourself.
